scope: Mac encrypted5GHz160MHz and simulated PON endpoints. Formal Flash radio, no RAM replacement or sampler for the primary cold measurements; no physical PON egress or optical negotiation.

duplex_loss_location: The266-packet difference between uplink FE and received counts plus the24-packet difference between downlink FE and PE counts equals the290 L3 tail drops. Both TCP sockets match FE. This locates loss within NI delivery, not its precise queue/credit cause.

diagnostic_followup.status: Timed out25s; management connection then unavailable. Not a valid throughput result.
diagnostic_followup.sampler: Read-only CPU0 EPP/refill sampler,100us, pinned CPU0, bounded100000 samples. No production admission, interrupt or buffer setting was modified.
diagnostic_followup.saved_archive_on_mac: qm-credit-events.tgz in the shared evidence directory
diagnostic_followup.compression: Serial transfer preserved every change of sampled numeric state plus constant-period endpoints; repeated-state timestamps were collapsed. This is not an unfiltered sample file.
diagnostic_followup.final_queue: EPP empty, IRQ enable bits255, refill pending0. No additional tail drops were observed, so this trace cannot establish the cause of the earlier290 drops.
diagnostic_followup.wireless_status: Later snapshots contain5GHz H2C timeouts and zero DMAC/CMAC/HAXI state registers. No explicit firmware-halt0x1000/DMAC0x100 record was captured for this incident. Sampler timing effects and the management failure were not isolated; do not classify it as the previously recorded payload-overflow halt.
diagnostic_followup.factory_readonly_findings: Original ca-ne.ko compiled defaults ca_ni_napi_budget=16 and ca_ni_use_qm_eq_refill_int=0; original refill allocation can precede protocol callbacks. These observations alone do not establish which current setting causes duplex drops; no NI change was made from that hypothesis.

recovery.action: Saved timeline/dmesg/radio state through TTL, removed sampler, stopped test server, sync, relay cold cycle. Firmware image retained.
recovery.verified: Same Flash radio hash; both APs operational; no diagnostic/test modules or table220 policy rule; console printk restored7/4/1/7. No performance rerun was used to replace the failed observations. External default route remains192.168.71.1/en5.

remaining_priority: Uninstrumented bidirectional NI tail-drop cause. Preserve confirmed Wi-Fi fixes and keep the separate sampling/management incident recorded without expanding it into the primary investigation absent stronger evidence.
